content.text: Cities are warmer than their surroundings, partly because concrete stores heat long {{gap:1}} sunset. Planting trees can help, provided {{gap:2}} they are given enough room to grow. Even {{gap:4}} a tree is young, its canopy can provide shade; {{gap:5}}, planners must not assume that planting alone will solve the problem.
